# Q Crypto

This repository holds the single audited post quantum cryptography crate for the Quantova stack. It implements ML KEM, ML DSA, SLH DSA, FN DSA, and SHA 3 directly from the NIST FIPS specifications and validates every primitive against the official NIST test vectors. It is the only source of cryptography in the organization and classical cryptography cannot be expressed here. Governed by the crypto policy in the Quantova Specs repository. Commits are authored by the owner only. Dual licensed under Apache 2.0 and MIT.
